annotations.title: Generate a complete evidence-linked life report

description: EXPERT FULL-REPORT TOOL — prefer consult_jyotishya (brief dossier + profileRef) for normal questions; use get_full_life_report_section for one section at a time. Builds a complete South Indian astrology report covering all major life areas, domain-specific timing outlooks, measured strengths, Vargas, structural Yogas, current Dasha and upcoming Antardashas. Timing activation identifies an area, never a specific event; interpretations remain qualified and evidence-linked.

asOfDate.description: ISO date or instant for the current-timing section; defaults to now

place.description: Catalogue query or display label when explicit coordinates are supplied

timezone.description: Required IANA timezone when explicit coordinates are supplied, for example Asia/Kolkata

timezoneOffset.description: Optional fallback offset; derived from timezone and the requested local date when omitted

name: generate_full_life_report
title: Generate a complete evidence-linked life report
